info.title: Phala Pay API
info.description: Authenticated merchant and administrative API for Phala Pay crypto payments.

get.summary: The account the API key belongs to, in the key's mode.

post.summary:
Updates the account's settings in the key's mode; parameters not sent are left unchanged.
`confirmation_policies` sets, per chain, the confirmation a payment must reach before it is
credited (design D1): the stricter of it and the route's floor applies to every deposit not
credited yet, and `GET /v1/config` reports it with its typical credit time. Announced as
`account.updated`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

post.summary:
Pauses the account's `quotes` in both modes, for an emergency such as a leaked key during a
treasury time-lock (design §12): no quote, deposit address, or network is issued until you
resume. Payments to existing addresses keep being credited. Announced as `account.updated`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

post.summary:
Resumes the `quotes` you paused. A pause the operator set stays in `paused_scopes` until the
operator lifts it. Announced as `account.updated`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

post.summary:
Rolls the webhook signing key of the key's mode: the next version signs every delivery from
now on, and the current one keeps signing beside it for `expires_in` seconds (at most 7 days),
so every delivery carries one `v1a` signature per key until then; `0`, the default, stops it
at once. Fetch and verify the new public key with `GET /v1/attestation`, pin it next to the
old one, and drop the old one when it expires. Announced as `account.updated`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and request within 24 hours returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

200.description: OK: the account with its new webhook key version

get.summary:
Every forwarder address issued in the key's mode, for quotes and for deposit address networks
(current and superseded), with the `(factory, implementation, salt, treasury)` it is derived
from: the export that keeps funds recomputable and sweepable without Phala Pay (design §13).
Pages follow `id` order.

post.summary:
Creates a merchant account after the operator's offline due diligence (design D8): records the
contact and the due diligence, decides live mode (`charges_enabled`, D12), and returns the
first secret key of test mode and, with live mode, of live mode. Each key's `secret` is shown
only in this response; send it to the contact, who rolls it on receipt. Audited.

200.description: OK: created, with its first secret keys

post.summary:
Updates an account: live mode (enabling it returns the first live key), the restricted flag,
or the contact. Audited, and announced to the account as `account.updated`. The operator does
not manage the account's webhook endpoints: the merchant does, with `/v1/webhook_endpoints`.

200.description: OK: updated, or already holding these values

404.description: Not Found: no account has this id

post.summary:
Issues a recovery key (design D7) after the operator verified the request with the recorded
contact, optionally revoking every key of the mode first. Audited, and announced as
`api_key.*` events with actor `admin`.

200.description: OK: the key with its `secret`, shown once

403.description: `testmode_charges_only`: a live key for an account without live mode

404.description: Not Found: no account has this id

post.summary: Pauses scopes of one customer of an account, for example `settlement` to stop crediting it.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: The account's identifier of its customer, its `client_reference_id`

post.summary: Resumes scopes of one customer of an account.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: The account's identifier of its customer, its `client_reference_id`

post.summary:
Pauses scopes of a whole account in both modes, for example `quotes` and `settlement` for an
abusive account or a sanctioned treasury. Audited, and announced as `account.updated`.

Resumes scopes of a whole account, for example after a sanctioned treasury was replaced and
reviewed. Audited, and announced as `account.updated`.

get.summary: One deposit of any account with its stored facts, transitions, and webhook events.

200.description: OK: the process's counters in the Prometheus text format, such as `topup_rpc_calls_total{provider, chain_id, method}`; they restart at zero with the process

parameters.name: block_key
parameters.description: `chain:{chain_id}` or `address:{address_id}`, as listed in the daily report

404.description: Not Found: no active or lifted block has this key

get.summary: The keys of the requesting key's account and mode, newest first, without their secrets.

post.summary:
Creates a secret key in the requesting key's mode. The response is the only time its `secret`
is shown; a replay of the request (`Idempotency-Key`) returns the key without it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

200.description: OK: the key with its `secret`, shown once

get.summary: One key of the requesting key's account and mode, without its secret.

delete.summary:
Revokes a key at once. The mode's last key that is neither revoked nor expiring cannot be
revoked, so the account always keeps a working key; to replace a leaked last key, roll it with
`expires_in: 0`.

409.description: `last_api_key`: the mode's last key that is neither revoked nor expiring; create or roll a key first

post.summary:
Rolls a key: returns a new secret key with the same name, and the old key keeps working for
`expires_in` seconds (at most 7 days), Stripe's roll; `0`, the default, revokes it at once. A
key may roll itself.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

200.description: OK: the new key with its `secret`, shown once

get.summary:
TDX evidence binding a fresh `nonce` to the webhook public keys of the key's account and mode
(design D11). Verify the quote once with the dstack verifier, check that its report data is
`report_data` zero-padded to 64 bytes and that `report_data` binds your nonce, account, mode,
and the listed keys, then pin the public keys: they are stable across releases.

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: Non-empty hexadecimal nonce of at most 32 bytes.

get.summary:
The assets, limits, and quote terms of the attested routes in the credential's mode, with the
confirmation your account's policy requires.

The account's deposit addresses in the key's mode, newest first, with Stripe's cursor
pagination.

post.summary:
Returns the customer's active deposit address, one address for every supported token on every
supported network of the key's mode where you have a treasury, issuing it if the customer has
none: the same request always returns the same address until it is rotated. It also adds the
address's network on a chain supported, or given a treasury, since it was issued, and replaces
a chain's network whose treasury changed.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

409.description: `deposit_address_cap_exceeded`, `paused`, `chain_frozen` (a new address and every chain is frozen or paused), `treasury_not_set` (no treasury on any chain that takes one), or `idempotency_key_in_use`

get.summary:
One deposit address. The customer's page can read the address's public view, with the
payments seen and credited in the last 24 hours, by a `client_secret` instead of an API key,
as a quote's page does.

parameters.name: client_secret
parameters.description: A `client_secret` of the address, to read its public view without an API key. Send the request without `Authorization`; the response then allows any origin.

200.description: OK: a `DepositAddress` to a request with an API key, a `ClientDepositAddress` to a request by `client_secret`

404.description: Not Found, also for a `client_secret` that is not this address's

post.summary:
Updates a deposit address's `metadata`, active or retired; parameters not sent are left
unchanged. Deposits already recorded keep their own copy.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

post.summary:
Retires an active deposit address and returns the customer's new one, a new address on every
network. Payments to the retired address are still credited at spot; stop showing it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

409.description: `deposit_address_retired`: already rotated; `paused`, `chain_frozen` (every chain is frozen or paused), `treasury_not_set`, or `idempotency_key_in_use`

429.description: Too Many Requests: the customer's rotation limit

get.summary:
The account's deposits in the credential's mode, newest first, with Stripe's cursor
pagination.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Only deposits to this quote's address

parameters.name: deposit_address
parameters.description: Only deposits to this deposit address, `da_…`

parameters.name: created[gte]
parameters.description: Created at or after, Unix seconds

parameters.name: created[lte]
parameters.description: Created at or before, Unix seconds

get.summary: One deposit.

post.summary:
Updates a deposit's `metadata`; parameters not sent are left unchanged. The quote's metadata is
not changed.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

get.summary:
The account's events in the key's mode, newest first, with Stripe's cursor pagination: the
notifications webhooks deliver, and the audit log of every key, endpoint, and account change
with its `actor`. An event stays listed whether or not any endpoint received it.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only events of this type, such as `deposit.credited`, or of a group, such as `deposit.*`

parameters.name: created[gte]
parameters.description: Created at or after, Unix seconds

parameters.name: created[lte]
parameters.description: Created at or before, Unix seconds

get.summary: One event.

post.summary:
Delivers an event again to one enabled endpoint, whether it was delivered there, stopped, or
never sent there (the Stripe CLI's `events resend`), with the same `webhook-id` and body. Use
it after re-enabling an endpoint for the events it missed.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

404.description: Not Found: no such event or endpoint

get.summary: The account's quotes in the key's mode, newest first, with Stripe's cursor pagination.

post.summary:
Quotes `amount` cents payable in `asset` on `chain_id`: a locked price, the exact token amount,
and a single-use address, valid until `expires_at`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

get.summary:
One quote, for example to resume a checkout page. The payer's browser can read the quote's
public view with its `client_secret` instead of an API key, as Stripe.js reads a PaymentIntent.

parameters.name: client_secret
parameters.description: The quote's `client_secret`, to read its public view without an API key. Send the request without `Authorization`; the response then allows any origin.

200.description: OK: a `Quote` to a request with an API key, a `ClientQuote` to a request by `client_secret`

404.description: Not Found, also for a `client_secret` that is not this quote's

post.summary: Updates a quote's `metadata`, in any status; parameters not sent are left unchanged.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

post.summary:
Cancels an open, unpaid quote; a canceled quote is returned unchanged. Later payments to its
address are credited at spot.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

409.description: `quote_payment_received`: the address already received a payment; `quote_window_closed`: past `expires_at`; `quote_unexpected_state`: complete or expired

get.summary: The account's refunds in the key's mode, newest first, with Stripe's cursor pagination.

post.summary:
Creates a `pending` refund of a final deposit (design D5): a rejected deposit other than a
sanctioned or dust one, or a credited one. The amount, the unrefunded remainder by default, is
reserved until the refund is canceled or fails. The destination must pass sanctions screening
(`400 destination_sanctioned`). The merchant then pays it from the refund's `treasury` and
attaches the transaction with `mark_paid`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

get.summary: One refund.

post.summary: Updates a refund's `metadata`, in any status; parameters not sent are left unchanged.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

post.summary:
Cancels a pending refund and releases its reservation of the deposit, whether or not a
transaction was attached; canceling a canceled refund returns it. Once its verification has
ended (`succeeded` or `failed`), a refund cannot be canceled.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

post.summary:
Attaches the transaction that pays a pending refund, as BTCPay's payout `mark-paid`. At
`finalized`, both providers must show a `Transfer` of the deposit's token from the refund's
`treasury` to `destination_address` for exactly `amount_atomic`, in a log no other refund uses
(`log_index`, or any such log when absent). Then the refund is `succeeded` and
`deposit.refunded` is sent; otherwise it is `failed` with a `failure_reason`. Repeating the same
transaction returns the refund.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

409.description: `refund_unexpected_state` (not pending, or marked paid with another transaction), `transfer_already_used`, or `idempotency_key_in_use`

get.summary:
The sweepable balances of the key's mode, by chain, token, and treasury, each with the
`factory.flush(treasury, salts, token)` call that moves them (design D4). A forwarder's
balance is its final deposits, reversed ones excluded, minus the finalized `Flushed` amounts,
so a sweep never counts a deposit that could still be reversed. A forwarder holding a deposit
rejected as sanctioned is never listed, and no call is built to a treasury a sanctions list
names. Anyone may send the call; the sender pays the gas. The Python SDK's `safe_batch` turns
the calls into a Safe Transaction Builder file.

The account's treasuries in the key's mode, newest first: each chain's `active` one, and any
`pending` change.

post.summary:
Sets the chain's treasury with a signed challenge. An EOA's `personal_sign` signature must
recover to the address; otherwise a contract deployed at the address must return `0x1626ba7e`
from EIP-1271 `isValidSignature` for the message's EIP-191 hash at the chain's `finalized`
block on both of the service's RPC providers. The address is screened against sanctions lists.
post.description:
The chain's first treasury, and any test-mode change, applies at once. A later live change is
`pending` for 48 hours (`account.treasury.pending`), then applies
(`account.treasury.updated`) unless canceled first: new quotes and deposit address networks
then pay it, while addresses issued before keep paying the former treasury and are still
credited. Treasury events go to every enabled webhook endpoint of the mode.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

200.description: OK: `active`, or `pending` for a later live change

400.description: `treasury_proof_invalid`, `treasury_challenge_expired`, `treasury_challenge_used`, `treasury_not_deployed` (no contract at the address at the chain's finalized block; ERC-6492 signatures are refused), or `treasury_sanctioned`

503.description: The chain or sanctions screening could not be read; retry

post.summary:
Issues the EIP-4361 message that proves `address` as your treasury on `chain_id` in the key's
mode. Sign it and send it to `POST /v1/treasuries` before `expires_at`: 10 minutes for an EOA,
24 hours for an address that holds code (a Safe, whose owners sign it as a Safe message); it
can be used once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

get.summary: One treasury.

post.summary:
Cancels a pending treasury change before it applies (`account.treasury.canceled`); the
chain's current treasury stays. If you did not request the change, also roll your keys.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

get.summary: The key's mode's webhook endpoints, newest first, with Stripe's cursor pagination.

post.summary:
Registers a webhook endpoint in the key's mode, at most 16 per mode. It receives the events it
subscribes to and, whatever it subscribes to, every account event (`account.*`, `api_key.*`,
`webhook_endpoint.*`), starting with `webhook_endpoint.created` about itself. Deliveries are
signed with the account's webhook key of the mode (`GET /v1/attestation`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

get.summary: One webhook endpoint.

post.summary:
Updates a webhook endpoint; parameters not sent are left unchanged. A change is announced as
`webhook_endpoint.updated`, with the replaced values in `data.previous_attributes`, to every
enabled endpoint, and first to this endpoint at the URL it had before, even when the change
disables it. Disabling stops its pending deliveries; enabling does not restart them (resend
with `POST /v1/events/{id}/resend`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

delete.summary:
Deletes a webhook endpoint. `webhook_endpoint.deleted` goes to every enabled endpoint, and
first to the deleted one; then it receives nothing more, and its pending deliveries stop.

post.summary:
Sends a `webhook_endpoint.test` event about the endpoint to this endpoint only, enabled or
not, signed like every delivery: check your receiver and its signature verification with it.
There is no URL challenge.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters; for 24 hours a repeat of the same request returns the first response, and of another request is `400 idempotency_error`.

AccountObject.description: The account of the request's API key (`GET /v1/account`), in the key's mode.

charges_enabled.description: Whether the operator enabled live mode.

confirmation_policies.description:
The confirmations you require on chains of this mode, stricter than the routes' (design
D1); a chain not listed uses its route's (`GET /v1/config`).

livemode.description: The mode of the key that reads it.

paused_scopes.description:
Active account-level pause scopes, the operator's and your own (`POST /v1/account/pause`):
while `quotes` is listed, no quote, deposit address, or network is issued. Your resume
lifts only your own pause.

webhook_keys.description:
The keys that sign this mode's webhooks: the current one first, then any previous one
still signing during a rotation. Their public keys come from `GET /v1/attestation`.

AccountPauseRequest.description: Administrative pause or resume of a whole account, in both modes.

scopes.description: Pause scopes to add or remove: `quotes`, `settlement`, `refunds`.

AccountResponse.description: An account as the operator sees it.

api_keys.description:
The secret keys this request issued, each with its `secret` shown only here: at creation
a test key and, with `charges_enabled`, a live key; on an update that enables live mode,
the first live key. Send them to the contact; the merchant rolls them on receipt.

charges_enabled.description: Whether the account may use live mode.

restricted.description: Whether the account is restricted for review.

scopes.description:
`["quotes"]`, the one scope a merchant pauses itself: no quote, deposit address, or
network is issued while it is paused. Existing addresses keep being credited.

AddressList.description: A page of addresses in `id` order (<https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination>).

has_more.description: Whether more addresses follow in the direction of this page.

AddressObject.description:
An address the account was issued (design §13): everything needed to recompute it and to
sweep it without Phala Pay.

address.description:
The forwarder address: `factory`'s `CREATE2` clone of `implementation` over `treasury`
and `salt`.

created.description: When the quote or deposit address it belongs to was created, Unix seconds.

deposit_address.description: The deposit address it is a network of, `da_…`; `null` for a quote's address.

implementation.description: The forwarder implementation the clone delegates to.

quote.description: The quote the address was issued for, `qt_…`; `null` for a deposit address's network.

treasury.description: The treasury the forwarder pays, fixed in its address.

AdminReasonRequest.description: Administrative action body; `reason` is recorded in the action's audit row.

reason.description: Why the action is taken, 1 to 1024 bytes: the incident or sign-off it rests on.

has_more.description: Always `false`: every key of the mode is listed.

ApiKeyObject.description: An API key (design D7). `secret` is present only in the response that created it.

expires_at.description: When a rolled key stops working, Unix seconds.

last_used.description: Last use, Unix seconds, to the minute.

redacted.description: The key's prefix and last four characters, such as `ppay_sk_test_…a1B2`.

secret.description: The whole key, `ppay_sk_…`, shown once. Store it in a secret manager.

status.description:
`active`; `expiring` for a rolled key that still works until `expires_at`; `expired`;
`revoked`.

AttestationResponse.description:
TDX evidence binding a nonce to the webhook public keys of the caller's account in the
caller's mode (design D11).

livemode.description: The caller's mode; each mode has its own key.

quote.description: Versioned dstack attestation bytes as lowercase hexadecimal.

report_data.description:
`sha256(len(nonce) ‖ nonce ‖ len(account) ‖ account ‖ livemode ‖ (version ‖
public_key)*)` as lowercase hexadecimal: lengths are one byte, `account` is UTF-8,
`livemode` is one byte (`1` live, `0` test), and each key of `webhook_keys`, in order, is
its version as 4 big-endian bytes and its 32 raw public-key bytes.

webhook_keys.description:
The keys that sign the account's deliveries in this mode: the current one first, then any
previous one still signing during a rotation.

ClientDepositAddress.description:
The public view of a deposit address, read with its `client_secret` and without an API key,
for the customer's page. It has no account, customer, treasury, or metadata fields.

address.description: The address shared by every network, or `null` when a network's differs.

livemode.description: Whether the address is in live mode; a test-mode page should say so.

networks.description: The address on each supported network, with the tokens it takes there.

payments.description:
Payments to the address in the last 24 hours, newest first, at most 10: display only,
never a reason to deliver anything.

status.description: `active`, or `retired` by a rotation (still credited; show the new address instead).

ClientDepositAddressNetwork.description: A deposit address on one network, as its public view shows it.

address.description: The forwarder address to pay on this chain.

assets.description: The supported tokens on this chain.

ClientDepositAddressPayment.description: A payment to a deposit address, as its public view shows it.

amount_atomic.description: Token amount in base units, as a decimal string.

asset.description: Asset code; `null` for a token without a route.

confirmations.description: While `seen`: blocks on top of and including the payment's block; otherwise `null`.

created.description: When the payment was first seen or recorded, Unix seconds.

decimals.description: The token's decimals, to display `amount_atomic`; `null` with `asset`.

status.description:
`seen` (in a block, below the route's confirmation, and may still disappear);
`confirming` (at the confirmation, being valued and screened); `credited`; `rejected`
(not credited; the payer should contact the merchant's support); or `reversed` (its
transaction left the chain before finality: the payment did not happen).

ClientQuote.description:
The public view of a quote, read with its `client_secret` and without a signature, for the
payer's checkout page. It has no account or internal fields.

amount.description: Credit in the currency's minor unit.

amount_atomic.description: The exact token amount to pay, in base units, as a decimal string.

confirmations.description: While `seen`: blocks on top of and including the payment's block; otherwise `null`.

expires_at.description: End of the payment window, Unix seconds.

livemode.description: Whether the quote is in live mode; a test-mode page should say so.

payment_status.description:
Progress of the payment shown on the page; display only, never a reason to deliver
anything: `none`; `seen` (in a block, below the route's confirmation, and may still
disappear); `confirming` (at the route's confirmation, being valued and screened);
`credited`; `rejected` (not credited; the payer should contact the merchant's support); or
`reversed` (credited, then its transaction left the chain before finality: the payment did
not happen, and the credit is taken back).

payment_uri.description: EIP-681 URI carrying the token, chain, address, and amount.

status.description:
`open`, `complete`, `expired`, or `canceled`, as on `Quote`; hide the address once
`expires_at` has passed.

Config.description: What a product's UI reads instead of hardcoding: assets, limits, and quote terms.

livemode.description: The mode of the key that reads it: `assets` lists that mode's routes.

max_open_amount_per_account.description: Per-account cap on the credit of open quotes, in cents; no single quote can exceed it.

ConfigAsset.description: A payable asset and its terms.

confirmations.description:
The confirmation a payment's block must reach before it is credited: a depth (`"2"`: the
block and one more), `"safe"`, or `"finalized"`: the stricter of the route's floor and
your account's `confirmation_policies`. A credit before finality can still be reversed
(`deposit.reversed`).

max_deposit_atomic.description: Maximum creditable deposit in base units, as a decimal string.

min_amount.description: Minimum credit in cents, for quotes and deposits; smaller deposits are not credited.

min_refund_atomic.description: Minimum refundable amount in base units, as a decimal string.

quote_spread_bps.description: A quote's price is spot / (1 + spread_bps / 10 000); spot-valued payments carry no spread.

quote_tolerance_bps.description: A payment within this many basis points of the quoted amount completes the quote.

quote_ttl_seconds.description: Payment window of a quote, in seconds.

typical_credit_seconds.description: Typical time from payment to the `deposit.credited` event, in seconds, at `confirmations`.

typical_finality_seconds.description: Typical time from payment to finality, in seconds; refunds wait for it.

ConfirmationPolicy.description: One chain's confirmation the account requires (design D1).

chain_id.description: A chain of the key's mode (`GET /v1/config`).

confirmations.description:
A depth (`"12"`: the block and eleven more), `"safe"`, or `"finalized"`: never weaker than
the route's `confirmations`, and of the chain's kind (a depth or `finalized` on Ethereum,
`safe` or `finalized` on an OP-stack chain). In a request, `null` removes the chain's
policy, so its route's applies.

Contact.description:
The merchant's contact recorded at onboarding (design D8): the operator's channel for the key
hand-over, recovery, incidents, and restores, and the only personal data kept.

CreateAccountRequest.description: `POST /v1/admin/accounts` body. Accounts are created only by the operator (design D8).

charges_enabled.description: Whether the account may use live mode (design D12). Default `false`.

due_diligence.description: The due diligence the decision rests on.

reason.description: Why the account is created, 1 to 1024 bytes.

name.description: The key's label, at most 200 characters.

client_reference_id.description: Your identifier of the customer, 1 to 200 characters; the customer is created on first use.

metadata.description:
Stripe's `metadata`: up to 50 string key/value pairs for your own use, keys of up to 40
characters without square brackets, values of up to 500 characters.
Merged into the returned address's, as `POST /v1/deposit_addresses/{id}` does: a key set to
`""` is unset. Every deposit to the address starts with a copy of it, and a rotation carries
it to the next version. Phala Pay never reads it. Do not store sensitive information in it,
such as personal or payment details.

amount.description: The credit to quote, a positive integer in the currency's minor unit (US cents).

asset.description: Asset code of the payment on that chain, such as `pha`.

chain_id.description: EVM chain of the payment, one of `GET /v1/config` `assets[].chain_id`.

client_reference_id.description:
Your identifier of the customer to credit, 1 to 200 characters (Stripe Checkout's
`client_reference_id`); the customer is created on first use.

metadata.description:
Stripe's `metadata`: up to 50 string key/value pairs for your own use, keys of up to 40
characters without square brackets, values of up to 500 characters.
A key set to `""` is omitted. The deposit that pays the quote starts with a copy of it.
Phala Pay never reads it. Do not store sensitive information in it, such as personal or
payment details.

amount_atomic.description: Amount in base units, as a decimal string; the unrefunded remainder when absent.

deposit.description: `dep_` id of the deposit to refund.

destination_address.description: Address the customer controls; never default it to the sender, which may be an exchange.

metadata.description:
Stripe's `metadata`: up to 50 string key/value pairs for your own use, keys of up to 40
characters without square brackets, values of up to 500 characters.
A key set to `""` is omitted.
Phala Pay never reads it. Do not store sensitive information in it, such as personal or
payment details.

address.description: The treasury address to prove: an EOA, or a contract deployed on the chain such as a Safe.

chain_id.description: The chain of the treasury: a chain of the key's mode (`GET /v1/config`).

signature.description:
Hex signature of the message: an EOA's 65-byte `personal_sign` signature, or what a
deployed contract's `isValidSignature` accepts (for a Safe, the owners' signatures of the
Safe message, or `0x` after `SignMessageLib` approved it). ERC-6492 signatures are refused.

enabled_events.description: The event types to deliver, such as `deposit.credited`, or `["*"]` for all.

metadata.description:
Stripe's `metadata`: up to 50 string key/value pairs for your own use, keys of up to 40
characters without square brackets, values of up to 500 characters.

url.description:
Where to deliver events, up to 2048 characters, without credentials or fragment: `https` on
port 443; in test mode also `http` on port 80. Redirects are not followed.

CustomerPauseRequest.description: Administrative pause or resume of one customer of an account.

livemode.description: The mode of the customer: customers of test and live mode are separate.

scopes.description: Pause scopes to add or remove.

DailyReportResponse.description: Daily finance report produced by C12.

exposure_minor.description:
Open rate-lock credit across all accounts in destination minor units: the sum the global
exposure cap is enforced against. This service always sends it; it is optional in the
schema so clients also parse reports from servers that predate it.

oneOf.description:
Latest reconciliation round of the serving process; absent until the first round after a
restart.

routes.description: SQL-computed metrics for each configured route.

Deposit.description:
A transfer to a quote's address or a deposit address at the route's confirmation: valued,
screened, and credited, or rejected; `reversed` if its transaction left the chain before
finality.

amount.description: Credit in the currency's minor unit (cents), once valued.

amount_atomic.description: Token amount in base units, as a decimal string.

amount_refunded_atomic.description: Refunded token amount in base units, as a decimal string: the sum of succeeded refunds.

asset.description: Asset code; `null` for a token without a route.

block_number.description: Number of the block the transfer is in; it changes if the transaction is re-included.

client_reference_id.description: Your identifier of the customer the deposit is credited to.

deposit_address.description:
The deposit address that received the transfer, `da_…`, on `chain_id` at `address`; `null`
for a quote's address. Payments to a deposit address, active or retired, are credited at
spot.

exchange_rate.description: USD per token, a decimal string with 8 places, once valued.

final.description:
Whether the deposit's block is final on both providers: a final deposit can no longer be
reversed, and only a final deposit can be refunded. A deposit is credited at the route's
confirmation, before it is final (`GET /v1/config` `typical_finality_seconds`).

id.description:
`dep_` and the hex of the deposit's deterministic UUID,
`uuid_v5(DEPOSIT_NAMESPACE, "{chain_id}:{tx_hash}:{receipt_log_index}")`, where
`receipt_log_index` is the transfer's position among its transaction's receipt logs.

livemode.description: Whether the deposit is on a live-mode route.

log_index.description: Block-wide log index of the transfer; it changes if the transaction is re-included.

metadata.description:
Your key/value pairs ([metadata](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata)): a copy of the
quote's or the deposit address's when the deposit is recorded, independent of it
afterwards; `{}` when none.

oneOf.description: The quote whose address received the transfer; `null` for a deposit address.

refunded.description: Whether the deposit is fully refunded.

rejection_reason.description:
Why the deposit was rejected: `unsupported_asset`, `below_minimum`, `out_of_bounds`,
`out_of_range`, or `sanctioned`.

status.description:
`detected`, `confirmed`, `credited`, `swept`, `rejected`, or `reversed` (the transaction is
not in the final chain: claw back a credit as for `deposit.refunded`). New values may be
added.

DepositAddress.description:
A customer's persistent deposit address, like a bank-transfer virtual account: one address for
every supported token on every supported network. Any amount of a supported token sent to it
is credited to the customer at the market (spot) price when it arrives. Rotation retires it and
issues a new one on every network; a retired address is still credited.

address.description:
The address shared by every network, when all of `networks` have the same one; `null`
when a network's treasury differs, and so its address (see `networks`), or when there is
no network.

client_secret.description:
Lets the customer's page read the address's public view, `ClientDepositAddress`, from
`GET /v1/deposit_addresses/{id}?client_secret=…` without an API key, to show a payment as
soon as it is seen. Returned only by `POST /v1/deposit_addresses` and `…/rotate`, each
time a new one; only its hash is stored, and the newest 10 of an address stay valid. Give
it only to the customer's page, and do not log it.

livemode.description: Whether the address is in live mode.

metadata.description:
Your key/value pairs ([metadata](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata)); `{}` when none.
Each deposit to the address starts with a copy.

networks.description:
The address on each supported network of the mode it was issued on, by `chain_id`, with
the tokens it takes there.

pending_payments.description:
Transfers to the address seen in a block but not recorded as deposits yet, oldest first:
display only (a reorg can remove one, and nothing is credited until its deposit is). Once
a transfer reaches the route's confirmation it is a deposit, listed by
`GET /v1/deposits?deposit_address=…`.

retired_at.description: Retirement time, Unix seconds; `null` while active.

salt.description: CREATE2 salt, 32 bytes of hex; the same on every network.

status.description: `active`, or `retired` by a rotation; payments to either are credited.

version.description:
The address's version among the customer's addresses, from 1. The salt is
`keccak256(abi.encode(account, livemode, client_reference_id, "deposit_address", version))`,
with the types `(string, bool, string, string, uint256)` and `account` your `acct_` id; it
names no chain or asset. On each network the address is the factory's `CREATE2` over that
network's treasury and the salt.

DepositAddressAsset.description: A token a deposit address takes on one network.

payment_uri.description:
EIP-681 ERC-20 transfer URI carrying the token, chain, and address, and no amount: the
payer chooses it.

DepositAddressList.description: A page of deposit addresses, newest first (<https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination>).

has_more.description: Whether more addresses follow in the direction of this page.

DepositAddressNetwork.description: A deposit address on one network (EVM chain).

address.description: The forwarder address to pay on this chain.

assets.description: The supported tokens on this chain; any other token sent to the address is not credited.

treasury.description:
The treasury the forwarder pays. The address is the same on every network whose treasury
is the same address.

DepositAddressPendingPayment.description: A transfer to a deposit address seen in a block and not yet recorded as a deposit.

amount_atomic.description: Token amount in base units, as a decimal string.

confirmations.description: Blocks on top of and including the transfer's block at the last head scan.

deposit.description: The `dep_` id the deposit will have once recorded.

DepositAddressView.description:
`GET /v1/deposit_addresses/{id}` returns a `DepositAddress` to a request with an API key and a
`ClientDepositAddress` to a request by `client_secret`.

DepositEventResponse.description: One webhook event about a deposit and its delivery state.

delivered_at.description:
When the last of the account's webhook endpoints accepted the event, or `null` while one
has not or the account has none.

id.description: Stable event identifier, sent as the `webhook-id` header: `evt_…`.

DepositList.description: A page of a list, newest first (<https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination>).

has_more.description: Whether more deposits follow in the direction of this page.

DepositResponse.description: A deposit's stored facts, for the operator (`GET /v1/admin/deposits/{id}`).

account.description: The merchant account the deposit belongs to, `acct_…`.

amount_atomic.description: Atomic token amount encoded as a decimal string.

client_reference_id.description: The merchant's identifier of the customer the deposit is credited to.

credit_minor.description: Credit in minor units encoded as a decimal string.

deposit_address.description: The deposit address that received the deposit, `da_…`; `null` for a quote's address.

final_at.description:
When both providers showed the transfer at or below `finalized`; `null` while the deposit
can still be reversed.

livemode.description: Whether the deposit is on a live route.

log_index.description: Block-wide transfer log index; it follows the transaction's re-inclusion.

price_scaled.description: Eight-decimal scaled price encoded as a decimal string.

price_source.description: Which price valued the deposit: `lock` (the quoted price) or `spot`.

quote.description: The quote whose address received the deposit, `qt_…`; `null` for a deposit address.

receipt_log_index.description:
Position of the transfer log in its transaction's receipt; with the chain and transaction,
the deposit's identity.

DepositTransitionResponse.description: One immutable state transition in a support timeline.

attempt.description: Retry attempt recorded for this transition.

DueDiligence.description:
The record of the operator's offline due diligence (design D8): a reference to it, when, and
by whom.

reference.description: Reference to the review in Phala's records, 1 to 200 characters.

ErrorDetail.description: Stable error fields safe to expose to callers.

message.description: Human-readable summary without internal details; it may change.

param.description: The request parameter the error is about, when there is one.

type.description:
Error category: `invalid_request_error` for any 4xx except an idempotency conflict,
`idempotency_error` for an `Idempotency-Key` reused with another request or still in use,
`api_error` for 5xx.

ErrorResponse.description:
Machine-readable error envelope returned by every API failure, Stripe's error object
(<https://docs.stripe.com/api/errors>).

EventList.description: A page of events, newest first (<https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination>).

has_more.description: Whether more events follow in the direction of this page.

actor.description: Who caused it: an API key id (`key_…`), `admin` (the operator), or `system`.

data.description:
`{"object": …}`, the object's API representation when the event was first delivered or
read, never re-rendered; `webhook_endpoint.updated` adds `previous_attributes`.

id.description: Event id, `evt_…`, also the `webhook-id` header of its deliveries.

pending_webhooks.description: Deliveries to webhook endpoints that are neither delivered nor stopped.

ExpandableDeposit.description: A deposit id, or the deposit with `expand[]`.

ExpandableQuote.description: A quote id, or the quote with `expand[]`.

FailedCheckReport.description: One reconciliation check that could not complete.

error.description: Error that stopped the check, without provider URLs.

name.description: The key's label, at most 200 characters.

reason.description: Why, 1 to 1024 bytes: how the request was verified with the recorded contact.

revoke_existing.description: Revokes every key of the mode first, for a leak the merchant cannot win by rolling.

log_index.description: Block-wide index of the `Transfer` log that pays the refund; any matching log when absent.

transaction_hash.description: Hash of the transaction that pays the refund from the treasury of the deposit's address.

MetadataClear.description: `""`: unset every key of the object's metadata.

oneOf.description: Keys to set, or with `""` to unset.

MetadataParam.description:
A `metadata` parameter: an object of string values, where `""` unsets the key, or `""` to
unset every key.

scopes.description: Pause scopes to add or remove.

PauseResponse.description: Current scopes after a pause mutation.

Quote.description: A quote: a locked price, an exact token amount, and a single-use address to pay it to.

amount.description: Credit in the currency's minor unit.

amount_atomic.description: The exact token amount to pay, in base units, as a decimal string.

client_reference_id.description: Your identifier of the customer the quote credits.

client_secret.description:
Lets the payer's browser read the quote's public view, `ClientQuote`, from
`GET /v1/quotes/{id}?client_secret=…` without your signature. Returned only by
`POST /v1/quotes`, since only its hash is stored; a repeat with the same `Idempotency-Key`
returns a new secret and the earlier one stops working. Give it only to the paying
customer's page, and do not log it.

oneOf.description: The deposit that completed the quote: its `dep_` id, or the object with `expand[]=deposit`.

exchange_rate.description: The locked price in USD per token, a decimal string with 8 decimal places.

expires_at.description: End of the payment window, Unix seconds.

id.description:
`qt_` id. The quote's address salt is `keccak256(abi.encode(account,
client_reference_id, "lock", id))` with the types `(string, string, string, string)`,
where `account` is your `acct_` id.

livemode.description: Whether the quote was created with a live key.

oneOf.description: The payment the checkout page should show, once one is seen on chain; display only.

payment_uri.description: EIP-681 URI carrying the token, chain, address, and amount.

status.description:
`open`, `complete` (a matching payment consumed it), `expired`, or `canceled`. A quote stays
`open` after `expires_at` until the finalized chain passes it, so a payment mined in time
is never reported as expired; hide the address once `expires_at` has passed.

treasury.description:
The treasury the address pays: your treasury of the chain when the quote was created. The
address is the factory's `CREATE2` over it and the salt.

QuoteList.description: A page of quotes, newest first (<https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination>).

has_more.description: Whether more quotes follow in the direction of this page.

QuotePayment.description:
A payment observed at a quote's address. Display only: while `status` is `seen` it is not
final, may still disappear in a reorg, and nothing has been credited.

amount_atomic.description: Token amount in base units, as a decimal string.

confirmations.description: Blocks on top of and including the transfer's block at the last head scan; `seen` only.

deposit.description: `dep_` id the deposit has, or will have once recorded.

estimated_final_at.description: Estimated finality time, Unix seconds: block time plus 15 minutes; `seen` only.

matches_quote.description:
Whether the payment is the quote's asset, in time, and within tolerance, so it will be
credited at the quoted price; otherwise it is credited at spot once final.

status.description:
`seen` (in a block, not recorded as a deposit yet) or `final` (recorded as a deposit at the
route's confirmation; it is final once its block is). New values may be added.

QuoteView.description:
`GET /v1/quotes/{id}` returns a `Quote` to a signed request and a `ClientQuote` to a request by
`client_secret`.

lifted_at.description: When the block was lifted; a repeated lift returns the original time.

check.description: Check that wrote the block, such as `address_derivation`.

scope.description:
`chain`: the chain is frozen. No check writes the `address` scope any more; it excluded an
address from the removed operator flusher.

ReconciliationRoundReport.description: Latest reconciliation round of the serving process.

failed_checks.description: Checks that could not complete; empty after a complete round.

Refund.description:
A refund of (part of) a deposit to the customer, which the merchant pays from the treasury of
the deposit's address and attaches with `mark_paid` (design D5).

amount_atomic.description: Token amount in base units, as a decimal string.

deposit.description: The refunded deposit: its `dep_` id, or the object with `expand[]=deposit`.

failure_reason.description:
Why the refund failed: `transaction_failed`, `transfer_not_found`, `sender_mismatch`,
`destination_mismatch`, `amount_mismatch`, or `transfer_already_used`. New values may be
added.

livemode.description: Whether the refund was requested with a live key.

log_index.description:
Block-wide index of the paying `Transfer` log: as named when marked paid, or found at
verification.

status.description:
`pending` (awaiting payment, or its transaction's finality), `succeeded` (the transfer is
final), `failed` (the attached transaction does not pay the refund; see
`failure_reason`), or `canceled`.

transaction_hash.description: The attached refund transaction, once marked paid.

treasury.description:
The treasury the refund must be paid from: the one the deposit's address pays, which may
differ from the account's current treasury.

RefundList.description: A page of refunds, newest first (<https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination>).

has_more.description: Whether more refunds follow in the direction of this page.

webhook_endpoint.description: The enabled endpoint to deliver the event to again, `we_…`.

expires_in.description:
Seconds the old key keeps working, up to 604800 (7 days); 0, the default, revokes it at
once.

Seconds the current key keeps signing beside the new one, up to 604800 (7 days); 0, the
default, stops it at once.

RouteDailyReport.description: Per-route daily finance report produced by C12.

age_in_state_max_seconds.description: Maximum age in seconds keyed by current deposit state.

credited_undelivered.description: Credited deposits whose `deposit.credited` webhook an endpoint has not acknowledged yet.

credited_undelivered_max_age_seconds.description: Age in seconds of the oldest of those events; zero when every one was delivered.

open_rate_lock_exposure_atomic.description: Sum of unconsumed rate-lock token amounts.

rejected_holds_atomic.description: Rejected token amount still held after succeeded refunds.

unflushed_balance_atomic.description:
Deposits not reversed minus finalized `Flushed` amounts: what the route's forwarders
still hold for their merchants to sweep.

events.description: Webhook events about the deposit in ascending creation order.

SupportDepositResponse.description: Deposit facts with the full immutable transition timeline.

Sweep.description:
One `factory.flush(treasury, salts, token)` call that sweeps the listed forwarders' balances
of one token to one treasury (design D4). Send `transaction` from any wallet, or put it in a
Safe Transaction Builder batch; the sender pays the gas.

addresses.description: The forwarders swept, at most 200 per sweep.

amount_atomic.description: The sum of `addresses[].amount_atomic`, in base units, as a decimal string.

asset.description: Asset code; `null` for a token without a route, which is swept all the same.

transaction.description:
The call: `to` the factory, `data` the ABI-encoded `flush(treasury, salts, token)`, and
`value` zero.

treasury.description: The treasury the forwarders pay, fixed in their addresses.

SweepAddress.description:
A forwarder's sweepable balance of one token: its final deposits minus the finalized
`Flushed` amounts, as the chain showed them at finality.

amount_atomic.description: Sweepable amount in base units, as a decimal string.

data.description: The sweeps, by chain, token, and treasury.

SweepTransaction.description: A contract call, as a wallet or the Safe Transaction Builder takes it.

value.description: Native value in wei, as a decimal string: always `"0"`.

Treasury.description:
An account's treasury of one chain and mode (design D10): the only address the forwarders
issued over it can pay.

canceled_at.description: When it was canceled, Unix seconds.

cancellation_reason.description:
Why it was canceled: `requested` (you canceled it) or `sanctioned` (a sanctions list named
the address when the change was due to apply, so it never applied).

created.description: When it was proven, Unix seconds.

effective_at.description:
When the treasury applies or applied, Unix seconds: at once for a chain's first treasury
and in test mode, 48 hours after the proof for a later live change.

kind.description:
`eoa` (an EIP-191 signature recovered to the address) or `contract` (a deployed
contract's EIP-1271 approval).

replaced_at.description: When a later treasury replaced it, Unix seconds.

status.description:
`pending` (a live change waiting for `effective_at`; cancel it with
`POST /v1/treasuries/{id}/cancel`), `active` (the chain's current treasury: new quotes and
deposit address networks pay it), `replaced` (a former treasury; addresses issued over it
still pay it), or `canceled`.

TreasuryChallenge.description:
An EIP-4361 (Sign-In with Ethereum) message proving a treasury, usable once: valid for 10
minutes for an EOA, 24 hours for an address that holds code (a Safe).

expires_at.description: When the message stops being accepted, Unix seconds.

message.description:
The EIP-4361 message to sign, exactly as given: `domain` and `URI` are the API's origin,
the statement names your account and mode, and `Chain ID` is `chain_id`. An EOA signs it
with `personal_sign` (EIP-191); a Safe's owners sign it as a Safe message (EIP-1271).

UpdateAccountObjectRequest.description: `POST /v1/account` body; parameters not sent are left unchanged.

confirmation_policies.description: The confirmations to require, per chain; chains not listed keep theirs.

UpdateAccountRequest.description: `POST /v1/admin/accounts/{account}` body; absent fields stay as they are.

charges_enabled.description:
Enables or disables live mode. Enabling it for an account without a live key returns the
account's first live key.

restricted.description: Marks the account restricted for review.

UpdateMetadataRequest.description:
`POST /v1/quotes/{id}`, `POST /v1/deposits/{id}`, `POST /v1/refunds/{id}`, and
`POST /v1/deposit_addresses/{id}` body: the
object's updatable parameters, of which `metadata` is the one.

metadata.description:
Stripe's `metadata`: up to 50 string key/value pairs for your own use, keys of up to 40
characters without square brackets, values of up to 500 characters.
Merged into the object's: a key set to a value is set, a key set to `""` is unset, other
keys are kept, and `metadata: ""` unsets every key.
Phala Pay never reads it. Do not store sensitive information in it, such as personal or
payment details.

UpdateWebhookEndpointRequest.description: `POST /v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}` body; parameters not sent are left unchanged.

disabled.description:
`true` disables the endpoint, `false` enables it. A disabled endpoint receives nothing and
its pending deliveries stop; resend missed events with `POST /v1/events/{id}/resend`.

metadata.description:
Merged into the endpoint's metadata: a key set to `""` is unset, and `metadata: ""` unsets
every key.

url.description: A new URL, as on creation.

WebhookEndpointList.description: A page of webhook endpoints, newest first (<https://docs.stripe.com/api/pagination>).

has_more.description: Whether more endpoints follow in the direction of this page.

WebhookEndpointObject.description:
A webhook endpoint (design D11): where the account's events of one mode are delivered, signed
with the account's webhook key of that mode.

disabled_reason.description:
`gone` when Phala Pay disabled the endpoint because it answered `410 Gone`; `null`
otherwise. Failing deliveries never disable an endpoint: they are retried until delivered.

enabled_events.description:
The event types delivered, or `["*"]` for all. Account events (`account.*`, `api_key.*`,
`webhook_endpoint.*`) are delivered to every enabled endpoint whatever this lists.

WebhookKeyObject.description: One version of an account's webhook signing key, with its public key.

expires_at.description: When a rolled key stops signing, Unix seconds; `null` for the current key.

public_key.description:
Raw ed25519 public key as lowercase hexadecimal. Pin it after verifying the attestation:
every delivery carries a `v1a` signature by it.

version.description: Key version, from 1; it grows by one per roll.

WebhookKeyVersion.description:
One version of an account's webhook signing key; its public key comes from
`GET /v1/attestation`.

expires_at.description: When a rolled key stops signing, Unix seconds; `null` for the current key.

api_key.description: A secret key, `Authorization: Bearer ppay_sk_test_…` or `ppay_sk_live_…`; the key selects the account and the mode. HTTP Basic is not accepted.

http_message_signature.name: Signature
http_message_signature.description: The operator's admin API only: an RFC 9421 ed25519 signature over `@method`, `@target-uri`, `content-digest`, and `idempotency-key` when sent. `@target-uri` is the service's configured public origin (`TOPUP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`) followed by the request path and query, so sign the public URL you call; `Host` and `X-Forwarded-*` headers are ignored.
